rules.text: NO-GO if any critical question is 'no' or the weighted score is below 60; CONDITIONAL GO if any critical question is 'partial'/'unknown' or the score is below 75; otherwise GO.

harborline.name: Harborline Logistics (fictional)
harborline.profile: Third-party logistics, 850 users across HQ and 4 warehouses (one in Mexico); Exchange 2019 on-premises in hybrid with Microsoft 365; 9 TB of file shares; target Google Workspace + Gemini pilot.

answers.question: Executive sponsor named and committed to the timeline?
answers.evidence: COO Janet Okoro sponsors; target go-live April 2027.

answers.question: Steering committee cadence and go/no-go decision-maker agreed?
Directory clean (no stale or duplicate accounts; sign-in names match email)?
answers.remediation: Disable/clean the 290 stale accounts and fix 64 mismatched UPNs before provisioning.

answers.question: SSO / identity-provider approach decided?
answers.evidence: Federate with the existing third-party IdP.

answers.question: Admin access to the DNS zone and an approved change window for MX?
answers.evidence: DNS run by an external web agency; no contact confirmed.
answers.remediation: Get named DNS contact and a signed change window; test with a TXT verification record.

answers.question: Bandwidth sufficient for bulk transfer (>= 500 Mbps off-hours)?
Retention and legal-hold requirements documented with an owner?
Data inventory available (mailboxes, shares, archives, PSTs)?
answers.evidence: Mailbox report available; file-share scan pending.
answers.remediation: Run the Atlas pre-flight scan on shares.

answers.question: Applications that send mail (SMTP relay) inventoried?
answers.evidence: 6 apps known; WMS alerts and label printers unknown.
answers.remediation: Log SMTP connections on Exchange for 14 days to find every sender.

answers.question: Outlook / Exchange-dependent add-ins identified?
answers.evidence: Sales uses a CRM Outlook add-in; no Workspace equivalent chosen.
answers.remediation: Confirm the CRM vendor's Gmail add-on or browser extension.

answers.question: Mobile policy decided for Google accounts (BYOD / managed)?
Desktop approach decided (browser-first vs sync clients)?
answers.evidence: Browser-first; Drive for desktop for finance.

answers.question: Client change owner and champions identified?
answers.evidence: HR business partner owns change; 25 champions named.

answers.question: Training windows and blackout periods known?
Help desk briefed and staffed for hypercare?
answers.evidence: Outsourced help desk not yet briefed.
answers.remediation: Include help desk in the champions programme and give them the hypercare runbook.

answers.question: Licences procured and billing set up?
